_comment: Session 52: this file used to be a fixed, hand-authored LIST of four
final_area), one dialogue block per step. Journeys (Yoda Stories' 'New
World' option) can shuffle the biome order per playthrough, so a step's
dialogue can no longer be authored against one specific (source,
target) pair. Instead each biome carries its own three authored phrases
-- how the Guide describes opening it, how he describes it staying
shut, and how he describes it opening -- and `templates` below splices
a source biome's name/fragment into them. Journey 1's canonical order
reproduces the original hand-authored text almost verbatim; see
_comment_routes: Session 53: a journey now also picks a ROUTE -- the shape of the chain,
not just its order. `old_road` is the straight line sessions 45-52
built (one frontier open at a time, each unlocked by the previous
step's trade, all four fragments required) and is what every existing
save is on. `open_frontier` is wayfarer_adventure.md's own unbuilt
stretch goal ('any 2 of 3 fragments unlock the final area'), scaled to
this game's four biomes: every frontier open from the start, walked in
any order, and the seal answers to three of the four -- so one biome is
genuinely optional. `chained` is what distinguishes them: it decides
whether a step unlocks the next biome (and therefore whether more than
one step can be offered at once).
_comment_knobs: knobs, not two names for one route shape. Session 53 shipped only the
two corners where they agree (chained+all, open+fewer) because the
chain builder hung the Final Area off the LAST BIOME STEP whenever the
route was chained, which forces the seal to cost every fragment. The
builder now decides that separately: the seal rides the last biome step
only when a chained route also wants every fragment (the legacy Old
Road shape, kept byte-identical for journey 1), and otherwise gets its
own biome-less step wanting a COUNT -- which is what makes the other
two corners below expressible. Any (chained, required_fragments) pair
is now authorable here with no code change; the four routes shipped are
the four corners, not a closed set.

routes.name: The Old Road
routes.blurb: One frontier at a time, each opened by the trade before it. The frontier as it has always been walked.

routes.name: The Open Frontier
routes.blurb: Every frontier open at once, walked in any order -- and one biome is yours to skip entirely.

routes.name: The Wide Frontier
routes.blurb: Every frontier open at once and walked in any order, but the seal answers to nothing less than all four fragments.

routes.name: The Short Road
routes.blurb: One frontier at a time as on the Old Road, but the seal breaks at three -- so the last leg is yours to walk or leave.

scorched_wastes.approach: The eastern road into the Scorched Wastes is buried under ash, and I'm the only one who still knows where it ran.
scorched_wastes.opened: The eastern road is yours now. The Scorched Wastes await, adventurer -- carry water.

frostreach.approach: The northern pass into the Frostreach is sealed by old magic.
frostreach.opened: The northern pass is open to you now. The Frostreach awaits, adventurer.

stormfell.approach: The western ruins of Stormfell answer to nothing but a storm's own fury.
stormfell.opened: The western ruins are open. Mind the lightning in Stormfell, adventurer.

fenmire.approach: South of here the Fenmire swallows every path whole -- but I'll open a way through the bog.
fenmire.opened: The Fenmire's paths are open. Watch your footing in the bog, adventurer.

templates.step_intro: {target_approach} Bring me proof you've bested {source_prose} and I'll open the way.
templates.step_incomplete: {target_sealed} without word from {source_prose}. Come back once you've claimed what's guarded there.
templates.final_intro: Four fragments, four corners of the frontier -- if {source_prose} has truly given up its own, you hold everything the old seal at the world's heart was built to keep out.
templates.final_incomplete: The seal answers to all four fragments together, not three. Find what {source_prose} guards.
templates.final_success: Ember, frost, storm, and mire, all in one hand -- the seal breaks. What waits beyond is yours to face, adventurer. Go carefully.
templates.open_greeting: Every frontier out there stands open, and I'll take them in whatever order they fall. {required_fragments} fragments of the {total_fragments} will break the seal.
templates.open_intro: {source_prose} still keeps what it keeps. Bring me its fragment and I'll count it against the seal.
templates.open_incomplete: No word yet out of {source_prose}. Come back once you've claimed what's guarded there.
templates.open_success: {fragment_name} -- so {source_prose} yields at last. Lay enough of these before me and the old seal will listen.
templates.openfinal_intro: The seal at the world's heart answers to {required_fragments} fragments, not all {total_fragments} -- and it's yours to say which {required_fragments}. Show me them and the road to {final_name} is open.
templates.openfinal_incomplete: {required_fragments} fragments, laid side by side. You aren't there yet.
templates.openfinal_success: {required_fragments} is enough -- the seal breaks. What waits beyond is yours to face, adventurer. Go carefully.
templates.chained_greeting: One frontier at a time, and the road opens ahead of you as you walk it. Any {required_fragments} fragments of the {total_fragments} will break the seal.
templates.open_greeting_all: Every frontier out there stands open, and I'll take them in whatever order they fall. Nothing less than all {total_fragments} fragments will break the seal.
templates.chained_greeting_all: One frontier at a time, and the road opens ahead of you as you walk it. Nothing less than all {total_fragments} fragments will break the seal.
templates.fullfinal_intro: All {required_fragments} fragments, the whole of the frontier in one hand -- lay them before me and the road to {final_name} is open.
templates.fullfinal_incomplete: All {required_fragments} fragments, laid side by side, and no fewer. You aren't there yet.
templates.fullfinal_success: All {required_fragments} -- the seal breaks. What waits beyond is yours to face, adventurer. Go carefully.
